event_name: Date 20 March 2022 Time 18:54 2022 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 18 - 20 March 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 2 (d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that OCO attempted to overtake MSC during lap 1 to the inside approaching turn 6. Although OCO backed out as MSC turned in, the front left of OCO's car made contact with the right rear of MSC's car, causing MSC to spin and continue. It was considered that the move was not done in a safe and controlled manner by OCO. Therefore the Stewards determine that this is a breach of the above regulation by OCO.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
